picks.why: 異動：價格跌破短期持有者成本與真實市場均價，今日發現 2026-11-05-1 的起點
picks.zh:
收盤由 $80,441 跌到 $75,980，跌破真實市場均價 $77,618，也貼著短期持有者成本 $75,989。短期持有者只剩 27.4% 在獲利，一週前是 41.6%。
#比特幣 #BTC #鏈上數據
picks.en:
The close fell from $80,441 to $75,980, below the true market mean at $77,618 and right on the STH cost basis at $75,989. Only 27.4% of short-term holder supply is in profit, down from 41.6% a week ago.
#Bitcoin #BTC #onchain

picks.why: 今日發現 2026-11-05-1：七成短線籌碼落入虧損，下方 74K 到 66K 籌碼薄
picks.zh:
短期持有者 372.8 萬顆、平均成本 $75,344，最厚一格在 76–78K（62.5 萬顆，CheckOnChain，11/05）。收盤 $75,980 落在這一格下緣，上週接手的這批籌碼回到成本附近。
#比特幣 #BTC #鏈上數據
picks.en:
Short-term holders hold 3.73M BTC at an average cost of $75,344, thickest at 76–78K (625K BTC, CheckOnChain, Nov 5). The $75,980 close sits at the bottom of that bucket, so last week's buyers are back near cost.
#Bitcoin #BTC #onchain

picks.why: 今日發現 2026-11-05-2：大跌那天美元現貨仍在折價
picks.zh:
BTC 一天跌 5.55%，Coinbase 溢價仍是負的：最新一天 −0.156%、7 日平均 −0.170%、30 日平均 −0.137%。美國現貨價格低於幣安，下跌時沒有美元買盤接手。
#比特幣 #BTC #資金流
picks.en:
BTC fell 5.55% in a day and the Coinbase premium stayed negative: −0.156% on the latest day, −0.170% on a 7-day average, −0.137% over 30 days. US spot trades below Binance; no dollar buyers stepped in on the drop.
#Bitcoin #BTC #flows
